page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left margin. Right margin has only edge marks, no text. Running head at top; page number 226 at top left; catchword at bottom right.

main_text.l: fuit autem Materia illa quæ causam de-
dit juratione, radix ejus obligationis quæ ex
actus cui adjungitur, id est Materiæ circa
Casus ultimus est, de solutione vinculi
per Relaxationem Partis, ejus sc. cui
juratum est: ut si Caius Titio aliquid
Juramenti gratiam facere, apud bonos autho-
res non uno semper sensu accipi. Su-
ille paratus est jurare, contentus volun-
tate non postulat ab eo Juramentum, sed
injurato credit, vel alia quacunque de
{b} b l 2. ff. de pecul. legat.

page.notes: Right margin shows only small edge marks; no printed text there. The left-margin note marked "a" is printed as "* 42. reg. Jur. in Sexto."; the note marked "b" is printed as "ᵇ l 2. ff. de pecul. legat." and the "l 2" reading is doubtful. "Cafus 61" is italic in the margin and read as Casus, since the long s is printed as f. The page opens mid-sentence, so the first paragraph is marked as continued. The heading "S E C T. VIII." is spaced capitals and is read as a division heading. Spelling of "Juramenti" and "juratione" follows the printed j, since j is a consonant here. Pages with "injurato" keep the printed j.
